guidance.summary: Target to open 40 to 50 stores in FY25.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: We are primed and ready in terms of opening around 40-50 stores.

guidance.summary: Commitment to open 40 to 45 stores annually.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: we have that kind of inventory to at least commit saying 40-45, we will do, every year.

guidance.summary: Store additions to increase to 60-70 per year in 2-3 years.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: in another two to three years, this 40 should go to a 60 or a 70 per year.

guidance.summary: Target new store openings to be 10% to 15% of store count.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: I've been saying this repeatedly that typically 10% to 15% of my number count should be my new store opening, broadly.

guidance.summary: Target 40 to 60 store openings over the next three years.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: So, you can take a range of 40 to 60 over the next three years.

guidance.summary: Blended gross margin expected to remain between 14.5% and 15.5%.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: I think 14.5%, 15%, 15.5%, those are the kind of ranges we play in from a gross margin standpoint.

guidance.summary: FY25 GMA contribution expected to be equal to or better than FY24.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.

guidance.summary: Aspiration to maintain a 15% to 20% revenue CAGR growth rate.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: It is getting more and more challenging to maintain a 15% to 20% CAGR growth rate if I continue to grow at only 40 stores per annum.

guidance.summary: Aspiration to add 15% to 20% of store count in FY25.
guidance.speaker: Neville Noronha
guidance.quote: The theme is the same, 15%, 20%. Okay? You replace everything that I said, 15% with 20% even for this year, right? That's the aspiration.
